messages:
alex: Heads-up — raptor-prod error-rate spiked ~1728749800 and customers seeing 502s but I didn't get paged. inc-bot posted to #incidents only. @ops-oncall can you check pager delivery? :eyes:
inc-bot: ALERT: raptor-prod error_rate > 5% over 5m. Severity: P1. DeliveryStatus: channel_posted (pager delivery suppressed by pagerlink). See internal link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/1728749800
sarah: On it. Can someone confirm whether PagerFlow/PagerLink accepted the webhook from notify?
ops-oncall: I didn't receive a page. Checked outgoing webhook logs from notify -> PagerLink: notify returned 200, PagerLink returned 503 on the delivery attempts. I'm triggering a manual page to the rotation now.
jordan: Manual SMS page sent to rotation, oncall confirmed receipt. Customers: several enterprise tenants report increased latency + 502 on inference-api. Starting customer impact triage.
leah: Drafting status page now. Quick notes: impacted customers: AcmeCorp, DataLayer, two others. SLA risk — engineering rolling mitigation.
alex: Quick mitigation: try bypassing the suppressor on PagerLink to force delivery while we debug. Command I ran (examples):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.pagerlink/_admin/bypass \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  -d '{"suppress":false, "reason":"prod alert bypass"}'
```
inc-bot: debug hint: suppressor rejected payload due to header mismatch. Incoming header `X-Incident-Route: oncall-v1` vs PagerLink expected `X-Route`. Suppressor logic flagged it as non-delivery. Sample log: `reject: missing header X-Route, uid=abc123`
sarah: That header change was part of the notify rollout last week. Looks like PagerLink's suppressor wasn't updated. Can we normalize headers in PagerLink quickly?
ops-oncall: Pushing a small hotfix to normalize and accept both header keys now. Rolling patch to pagerlink service (version +1). Will requeue undelivered alerts after deploy.
jordan: Requeued the 6 undelivered alerts after patch. I also invoked manual page fallback for any 5xx from PagerLink for the next 30m.
leah: Status update 1 posted: "Investigation underway, manual pages sent, mitigation in progress" — linking internal incident doc. ETA to full remediation: ~20m.
ops-oncall: Patch deployed at 1728750400, re-attempts succeeded, pagers flowed. Confirmed oncall receipts, routing looks normal now.
sarah: Can we add an alert metric for suppressor-reject-rate > 0.1% and a runbook step: on 5xx from PagerLink after 3 attempts, auto-fallback to SMS? I'll open a PR.
jordan: Filed PR #3456 with fallback + tests. Also adding an integration test in staging to validate header variations.
leah: Customer comms updated: listed impacted tenants, noted mitigation. Ops will follow up with targeted outreach.
alex: Error-rate trending down — baseline restored ~2m ago. Good job. Please own a short postmortem: sarah + alex to lead. Tag incident as `pagerlink-header-suppress-2024-06`.
ops-oncall: Agree. I'll dump delivery traces and hand over logs to the postmortem doc. Closing live triage for now. :thumbsup:
